note: Branching does not create positive expectancy when p <= 0.5 under even money, and it does not remove the possibility of ruin under finite capital. It only changes the shape of the path.

config.resolution: debt_frac is the share of settled steps with either debt positive. clear_rate is the share of debt episodes that return both debts to zero before the path stops. median_clear_steps is among cleared episodes only. A two-sided book is the settled step of a branch; it was declared on the previous proposal.
